sutta: devas, and so forth. 32.1. Monks, I will teach you about the devas of the cloud dwelling order. Listen. And what monks are the devas of the cloud dwelling order? There are monks who cloud devas, warm cloud devas, storm cloud devas, wind cloud devas, and rain cloud devas. These monks are called the devas of the cloud dwelling order. So, you see even the cloud devas also got different types. There are some uh clouds that are cool clouds, some are warm clouds, some are storm clouds, some are wind clouds, some marine clouds.
